author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
Installing LVP stair treads properly takes a few extra steps, but every one of them helps create a stronger, longer-lasting staircase.
In this video, I show you how I cut back the old nosing, build a solid square structure with plywood and shims, make the riser, prep the surfaces for better adhesion, and roll the tread firmly into place. It takes more time than a shortcut installation, but the result is a durable vinyl stair tread that is far less likely to move, loosen, or fail.

Watch the full stair finish comparison to see how LVP stacks up against hardwood, tile, veneer, and sanding and staining👇🏼
